examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Check Box Shape
examples.description: This example shows how to set CheckBoxShape to implement check boxes in circle and rounded square shapes.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Check Box Color
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set mark to customize the color of a check box.

examples.title: Example 3: Customizing the Check Box Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a custom check box using contentModifier. This check box comes in the custom pentagon style. When selected, the check box shows a red triangle pattern inside, and the title displays the word "Selected;" when deselected, the check box hides the red triangle pattern inside, and the title displays the word "Unselected."

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Text Check Box Style
examples.description: This example configures the selected style of a check box to display as text using the indicatorBuilder property.

examples.title: Example 5: Obtaining the Check Box Selection Information
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to obtain selection information by selecting check boxes and check box groups.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing Swipe-based Multi-Selection
examples.description: This example implements swipe-based multi-selection for Checkbox components through gesture event configuration.
